basic_info.description: This is your opportunity to create your dream home in one of Potrero Hill's most coveted locations. Perched at the top of a flat, dead-end block, this charming two-story residence offers expansive bay views and unbeatable convenience just minutes from Potrero Hill's beloved shops, restaurants, and cafes. Inside, the home features up to six bedrooms, ideal for flexible living. Four bedrooms are upstairs, while the main level includes two bedrooms perfect for guests, a home office, or other creative uses. The formal dining room adds warmth and character, while the spacious kitchen with water views from the sink invites transformation into the heart of the home. Even the laundry room has incredible views. The backyard is ready for your dream garden or outdoor retreat. The massive basement, with its own street entrance, provides incredible versatility for a possible ADU, Airbnb, large garage, or additional living area. A rare fixer in a prime San Francisco location, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to reimagine a timeless classic!
